reviews.text: Excellent and caring staff. Very pleasant experience for me and kitty. I've switched vets to come here. Very reasonable pricing.Just wanted to leave an updated review.  Still 5 stars. Exceptional service and pricing. I'm so happy to have Brilliant taking care of my baby.
Lovely quiet. Easy to get to.

I’ve now brought two of my bulldogs to Brilliant Vets, and I’ve had an excellent experience every time. The entire team is friendly, accommodating, and communicates clearly throughout the process, which makes a stressful situation so much easier.

The veterinarians we’ve seen have taken the time to explain treatment options in a way that’s easy to understand, while also considering what makes sense for my life as a pet parent. I really appreciate that they balance great medical care with practical, realistic recommendations rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.

I’m very grateful to have found a veterinary practice I trust, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Brilliant to other pet owners.

I like this veterinary clinic. One thing I really appreciate is that they have a scale available in the waiting area, so you can weigh your pet before being seen, although the veterinarian will weigh them again during the visit.
The clinic is also very clean. Everything appeared well-maintained, and even the bathroom was spotless, which says a lot about how the facility is cared for.
Overall, I’ve had a positive experience here and would recommend it to other pet owners.

I cannot say enough nice things about Brilliant Veterinary Care. Dr. Bishop is the best vet we have ever had. My cat suddenly developed welts and scabs and started vomiting, wheezing, hiding all day every day, and peeing everywhere but his litter box. Dr. Bishop suspected allergies and gave us a few inexpensive remedies to try first, instead of reccomending expensive allergy meds from the get-go. While the home solutions didn't work, and we ultimately had to cough up for the tailored medicationd, I appreciated that he exhausted all options before referring the most expensive treatment. I have had vets charge me hundreds of dollars for tests that didn't need to be run, medications that didn't need to be prescribed, and even medications I never picked up. Brilliant Vetrinary Care is NOT like that. They don't take advantage of you, which can be an easy thing to do when someone just wants their baby to feel better.

I am SO happy to say that my cat is now thriving. He isn't 100% better, and I don't suspect he ever will be (turns out, he is severely allergic to just about everything). But with the tailored treatment plan, he is no longer vomiting, his personality is back (I forgot how much he loves snuggles), and for the most part, he uses the litter box. Thank you SO much Dr. Bishop for genuinely changing my cat's life. Also, huge thank you to all of the incredible people who work the front desk. They are always so polite, considerate and professional. Brilliant Vetrinary care is truly THE best.

It has taken me almost two months to write this because losing my beloved cat Amada has been incredibly painful. But I wanted to express my deep gratitude to this veterinary office for the exceptional level of care, compassion, and humanity they showed us throughout Amada’s illness and passing.

I transferred Amada’s care here in July 2025 after another veterinary experience, and from the beginning Dr.Kutscher and the entire staff provided thoughtful, supportive, and deeply compassionate care. They were incredibly accessible, attentive, and always followed up. They understood that Amada was not “just a pet,” but family.

The kindness extended far beyond medical care. After Amada passed, I received an orchid and her paw print, gestures that touched me deeply during my grief.

I especially want to acknowledge the wonderful staff who supported us with such warmth and tenderness:
Karen in administration, Lori helping with messages by phone, Malcolm at the front desk who was always so helpful, Diandra and Julia who were present during Amada’s transition and held such a compassionate space, Nurse Maureen who even helped split Amada’s pills for me, and Cammy who personally delivered Amada’s ashes with such care and dignity.

And of course, Dr.Kutscher, whose flexibility, compassion, and supportive end-of-life care meant so much to both Amada and me.

I will always be grateful for the kindness, and dignity they showed Amada and for the care they extended to me during this time. 🌈🐈‍⬛

Dr Bishop and the gang are the best, which is why I keep recommending them to everyone I see, friends, strangers,people at the bus stop. But I probably shouldn’t because then I run the risk of them becoming too popular and I wont get a spot. Screw it, they’re such lovely people and they deserve every oz of goodness that they give to you. Plus, I love animals and I want your precious furry friends to be treated just as well as mine. So trust me when I say you’re in the best hands with Brilliant vets. They really are brilliant, and they really do care!
I'm happy to find a welcoming and friendly place for my senior dog. Thank you ❤️
Best in the city

The pandemic sure did a number on those of us with fragile animal family members that required immediate care by those that would get them in quickly and not fleece you in the process.  At the time I became a client of Brilliant Veterinary Care, I had two senior dogs who were really starting to  show their age, so I needed to be able to count on a practice that could get me in quickly, offer me clear, thorough and caring guidance for their continued care, and that would treat my anxious and ailing treasures as if they were own. I got, and continue to get, all that and more as a client of Brilliant.   They’re my go-to not only for my permanent canine family, but also for all the many foster pups I’ve brought their way.  They've also provided such loving support when it came time for me to make a tough decision. I couldn’t speak more highly of these terrific folks.

This place is great.
My dog was unfortunately very sick and elderly, and in a complete panic I brought him here. The place was about to close in ten minutes, but they took my dog in, ran tests, talked with me and my brother and my family on the phone, and gave us time to say goodbye. This place is very professional, clean, and efficient, but the compassion and understanding of their team is especially exceptional.
They are the most wonderful vet in the city. Wouldn’t have trusted my boy’s care to anyone else. Thank you for everything you have done. You guys are amazing!

If there was an option for 10 stars, I would give it. But I guess 5/5 is the highest we can go!

Brilliant Vet is a gift to UWS cat parents (and dog parents too… all the dogs I see in the waiting room seem very happy 😊)

My first experience was when my little cat Wyatt became suddenly ill at home on a Sunday. We called his normal vet on 72nd, and they said they could fit him in the following Thursday. We knew we couldn’t wait that long, so we called Brilliant Vet and hoped for the best. We spoke with Diandra who was so nice to a very concerned and nervous cat parent! She said his symptoms definitely sounded concerning and they would find a way to squeeze him in. They saw him that day at 3p. Dr Bishop did a thorough examination and helped us through Wyatt’s illness. I remember being so impressed with how he handled Wyatt and examined him! Wyatt is doing amazing today and Brilliant even helped guide us through his most recent onset of diabetes.

Is Brilliant vet expensive? Yes- but so is every vet practice on the UWS. When you put your money in to Brilliant Vet (a privately owned practice as opposed to private equity owned!) you know it is going only to the best care- not to shareholders or corporate ownership. They work well with every owner to guide treatment within budgetary ranges and even help many rescues like Frankie’s Feline Fund (a senior cat rescue) and Big Apple Cats (UWS cat rescue).

I am so grateful for their guidance, advice, and welcoming atmosphere. The entire staff is absolutely amazing. There is no better vet practice in the city, especially here on the UWS!

Brilliant Vet is absolutely the BEST!! From the minute you walk in, the desk staff are so welcoming and helpful and caring!  The Vets are also superb and I always feel beyond comfortable with the care they give to my dog. They also follow up with phone calls after a visit and are also available after hours!
I highly recommend everyone taking their beloved animal to Brilliant Vet!
Receptionists are rude and incompetent.

Hello. We would like to address your review of our clinic so the public has complete transparency. 

On Monday February 23rd, 2026, you made an appointment request through a third party app called Petdesk. Since you were not an established client our frontdesk emailed you to advise that we do not set up new clients through this app and requested you fill out a new client form that is easily accessible via our website. 

On Friday March 6th, our frontdesk received a new contact form (not the requested new client form) from you stating that you would like to establish care with us and inquired about our fees. You were advised of our office visit fee and cytology fee. You then asked if we would be able to see your pet and have your problem addressed at the same visit. We requested you call the clinic to speak with us to better explain the first visit process. 

On Wednesday 3/18/26 you called the clinic to set up your first visit and leave our required $125 deposit. We scheduled you for Monday 3/23/26. 

On Friday 3/20/26, our practice administrator, having been made aware of your Google review, called to discuss the review you left us without having stepped through our doors. During that call you cancelled your first appointment without giving any explanation of your review despite never having been to us. You were advised that your deposit would be returned and you simply hung up without offering your credit card information so we could process the return. Our practice administrator then emailed you asking for you to provide your credit card information and we are waiting for your response. 

We are at a loss as to why we earned a 1-star rating from you despite never having met you or your pet. 

We are always available should you need to discuss this further.

I’ve been to a bunch of vets over the years, but Brilliant Veterinary Care is by far the best. The staff is sweet, friendly & responsive, & Dr. Bishop has been a saint—knowledgeable, kind & compassionate. As long as I have pets here in the city, this is the vet I’ll be taking them to.

I can’t recommend Dr. Bishop at Brilliant Veterinary Care enough. I actually live on the East Side, but I make the trip because he is someone I trust with my dog’s care.

I brought my baby Caden in when his allergies became so severe that he was losing hair, and once again Dr. Bishop was incredibly patient, attentive, and thoughtful. Unlike some veterinarians who strictly follow a protocol, he truly listens and takes the time to understand what’s going on before offering knowledgeable, tailored solutions.

What I appreciate most is his consistently positive attitude and the calm reassurance he brings to every visit, it makes a stressful situation feel much more manageable.

If you’re looking for a vet who combines expertise with compassion, Dr. Bishop is absolutely worth the trip.
They are AMAZING. All of the doctors are amazing at following up and show genuine interest in my pet. Everyone is very kind and accommodating.

After moving to Lincoln Sq my cat Luna became suddenly ill and stopped eating and drinking. I went on the app Nextdoor to read reviews and recommendations of vets in the neighborhood, and even though it was a short bus ride for me, I found Brilliant Veterinary Care to have the best reviews. I brought Luna here, and they did some bloodwork and took a urine sample and found she had a UTI. After 2 antibiotic injections, she was back to her normal self. About a month passed, and the infection returned, and she deteriorated very fast. Another antibiotic shot didn’t help as her kidney values were too high. I had to make the decision to have her put to sleep. I found all the staff from the receptionists, nurses, and doctors to be very kind and show lots of empathy to Luna and myself. I decided to have Luna cremated and have a paw print done, and to my surprise, when I got the bill, they had done the euthanasia shot complimentary . I received her ashes back today and the paw mould, and it was really well presented. I just want to say thank you to all the staff there for doing their best for Luna and for being so kind. Happy Holidays

Dr. Bishop was great! He helped us with the concern professional and get the problem solved.
The team is responsive and helpful.

Dr. Bishop is a great vet. He is very caring and knowledgeable, he also cares a lot about your pet. I also have been very impressed with the front desk staff. Lori is amazing and always very on top of all my pets needs. They are also locally owned and have reasonable pricing for Manhattan.

My beloved cat Dexter recently passed and I’d like to take this opportunity to say how great the Brilliant team were in taking care of him. Dr. Bayazit never suggested any test or treatment that was unnecessary. She is kind, communicative and empathetic. The nurses are all so knowledgeable and treated him as if he was theirs. I highly recommend this practice for your furry companions.

I’ve seen Dr. Bishop for the last year or two for my two dogs Gingi and Lila. I’ve had Lila for 16 years and have seen a good handful of vets throughout that time- no one ever truly felt right. I can’t speak for the others at this office but Dr. Bishop is SO wonderful. He spends a lot of time with you sitting down and problem solving the best course of action. He is really detailed, patient and kind. After a pretty dramatic weight loss for my 16 year old dog, Dr. Bishop made a few suggestions. I trust him entirely but still like to do my own research - I was pleasantly surprised to see that ChatGPT recommended exactly the same course of action as Dr. Bishop. Highly recommend him and the office in general. It’s very clean and welcoming. They always have an availability for an emergency. Truly top notch. Fingers crossed that we will be his patients for many years to come!

Doctor Bishop was excellent!!!

I was very anxious about vets because of how other vets treated me and my old dog, but docroy B was a dream. He actually listened and wanted to help. There was no fuss, just complete transparency and respect.
You can tell this vet is about the animals and people, and not about putting your pet through stressful tests to get more money out of you.

Thank you to the Brilliant team👏🏼🤘🏼

Good place. My advice - ask for the estimate before you agree to expensive procedures. And don’t do it until you see the price and agree to it. I have made this mistake ( well… I did ask for the estimate … just never got it  and was stuck with a huge bill) wish I were less trusting
great staff, skilled, knowledgeable and caring doctors.

We recently adopted a rescue pup from Dallas, Texas and let me tell you, NYC is a scary place for this wee hound named Cello.  The staff at BVC totally understand and have been incredibly patient and gentle working with him and thankfully took a good deal of time to listen to my concerns so that they could advise me on the best path forward including training and treatments for his anxiety. The name fits- they are truly brilliant in the care and concern they provide. How lucky I feel that they are part of our wonderful neighborhood!

They truly are Brilliant!  Our new puppy became suddenly extremely ill.  Brilliant got us in right away and took swift action that saved our puppy’s life.  Everyone from the front desk to the nurses to the vets to the owner, treated us and our puppy with the upmost compassion and kindness.  We are so grateful to them all and feel so lucky to have this practice in our neighborhood!!

Again and again, these guys are incredible. I just got a call back in a holiday weekend from one of the owners. Helping diagnose and plan for treatment! They are incredible over and above again and again.
The best vet I’ve been to including outside of nyc! You can tell everyone there truly loves animals and it’s more than just a job for them.
The babes was constipated.  Her doctor cleared her up and we are at home again.  Her doctor is wonderful and caring both to her and me.

My pet was having an ‘emergency and it took someone 5 hours to return the call ,and I missed the called ,then they was closed,you would think that someone who was concerned about your pet would follow up with a phone call to check or to advise me what to do,it’s sad to think that they only show favorable care when they feel the need,it’s very disheartening from the front desk how they treat people when you call,I still haven’t received a phone call from his supposed to be veterinary care doctor /don’t waste your time with this place,I’m sure there are others that care!!!

We are sorry your experience was less than expected and we would love an opportunity to discuss your concerns. Please feel free to call us at 212-365-5160 and ask to speak with our practice administrator or nursing manager. Thank you and we hope your pet is doing well.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about these kind people. Dealing with pet owners must be an annoying/frustrating experience, but they never make you feel like that. Thank you for always taking such great care of my pup

I rarely leave any reviews but this one is worth it. I cant say enough how thankful and appreciative I am of having found Brilliant Vets. Everyone is so kind, accommodating, and most importantly extremely knowledgeable, professional, and  REALLY caring about the health and overall wellness of your pet. Oslo (my 6 month cat) and I are truly forever grateful to DR Kutscher and the entire staff here.

This is a group of the most professional and caring people that you can trust for the best pet care! Took my 13 year old cat in today and they were welcoming, efficient, and took great care of her. Highly recommend!!

Fabulous. Best Veterinary Care I've experienced.
Follow-up to Yelp Review.
Dr. Bayazit, and all the staff, especially Nurse Mauren & Handler Crystal that continue to give Bitsie her laser treatments [for a back injury in January] are truly exceptional.
In all my 55yrs living here in NYC, and having worked with many Veterinary Clinics/ Hospitals...Brilliant is the Gold Standard.
Nurse's Technicians & Receptionist are all caring, knowledgeable and professional. So glad I found them. Strongly recommend!!
5 STARS +
L.Stephan  & Bitsie Boo

Impossible to reach and provide poor guidance on medications. Have been bringing my cat here for just under a year and even getting prescriptions has been like pulling teeth.

Their reply below is disingenuous. I have called them multiple times over the past months asking for calls from my vet for guidance and received zero calls back. I have asked for prescriptions with refills given the lead time on my cats medications, they won't do it. I ordered the meds from a Canadian pharmacy at their recommendation due to the astronomical price of the medication domestically. They promised to teach us how to use the inhaler, they didn't. The promised to send us instructions on how to get the medication from Canada, they didn't.

I was recommended this vet by my family, and I love them! The wait wasn't long and the appointment itself was really quick for what I went in for. The vet I saw was really nice too, and answered all my questions

The best vet I’ve ever been to and I have owned dogs my whole life. They’re incredible kind and professional. They really went the extra mile to help get and appointment and make sure my dog was taken care of. Not to mention took how clean and nice the office is. 10/10 recommend!
So grateful to the brilliant vets and dr bishop! Switched from another “ well known “ place and what a difference ! ❤️ you guys actually care !
I have been going here for 3 years with my pup. They are always responsive, check in after shots, and Riley loves them!

This veterinarian care clinic is the best care clinic I have ever been to.. they were all so kind and so sweet. They actually made me cry when I got home because I’ve never felt so loved. They handled my new puppy like their own child. I would recommend this veterinarian clinic to anyone as their primary clinic out of every clinic in the city of New York. I’m sorry, but they’re the best here. Everyone deserves at least 50 bucks an hour. I can donate that too.🤍🫶🏽🙏🏽😭🇺🇸😇

We bring our 5-month-old Bernese Mountain Dog to Brilliant Veterinary Care, and we couldn’t be happier with our experience! Dr. Kristin Kutscher is absolutely wonderful—she’s so kind, thorough, and always takes the time to answer all of our questions.

The entire staff is incredibly lovely and welcoming, and the facility itself is clean and modern. 10/10 would recommend to anyone looking for an excellent vet in NYC!

The best vet's office I have found in nearly 18 years (and 4 cities) as a pet owner. I switched to BVC when my cat had a bad UTI and her former vet's entire office was out with COVID and could not see her on an immediate basis. BVC was extremely accommodating and from that moment on provided her with incredible care. Everyone in the office is warm and caring, and of course knowledgeable.

I brought her in this past weekend sensing that she was not herself and something was wrong, and they were incredibly kind and supportive when they shared her poor prognosis, and in helping me make the difficult decision to let her go. They made a heartbreaking experience as easy as possible for me. To top it off, they sent a beautiful flower arrangement and a note of condolences - going above and beyond. They are truly the best.

Brilliant Veterinary Care has been taking care of my two cats since we adopted them as kittens in 2023. Every member of their staff is kind, helpful, and really treats all of their patients (and pet parents) with care.

While other practices may sometimes feel like veterinary care is just a job, Brilliant Veterinary Care goes above and beyond every time.

I would recommend this practice to anyone who lives nearby, and would go as far as to say it's worth the subway trip if you don't live within walking distance.
My three cats were patients there. One only still alive. They are Accredited.
Staff and Drs are awesome.

We where visiting NYC & our dog was not well in sweden and needed to have a dialag with a vet & the team was kind enough to have a chat with us on the phone to give us ideas of what is going on and how urgent this matter is.
The best vet practice I’ve been to. So much attention and care is put into every visit. I truly feel like my pet is receiving the best care. Dr. Kutscher is amazing.

Brilliant Veterinary Care is the best vet I've ever been to. The whole staff is caring and patient, and the doctors really take their time to ensure you have all your questions answered and your pet is getting the best care possible. They'll usually call a couple days after an appointment just to check in on how your pet is doing post visit, going above and beyond in all aspects.

This is the best vet clinic I have ever been to. They are just as amazing as they are with our cats, as they are with humans. This place is such a treat, I always know Henri & Phoebe are going to be well cared for whenever I take them for a visit. Thank you for everything, you are truly brilliant! 😁 …

This review is long overdue.

tl;dr I wish I could give them 10/5 stars. You should absolutely bring your pets here.

I had to put my dog down unexpectedly early last year. I will never forget the team at BVC for supporting my dog DJ (and me) through this heartbreaking period with such grace, commitment and care.

Although thinking of DJ still brings me to tears, there are no feelings of regret or wondering if we should have tried this or that. I completely trusted the team and I knew that we were making the best decisions we could for DJ at every step. They made sure that I understood what was happening to him as things progressed, fully supported every decision I made, advised me on how to get him the best care that was within my budget and were so so generous throughout the week that we fought to get him better.

Thank you to everyone here that made one of the most devastating periods of my life manageable. I can't recommend the team enough.

Bonus, they always have availability and they're great with cats too! When my cat tore out her nail while playing they were able to see and treat her the same day.

The only reason I no longer bring my pets here is because I moved out to Brooklyn (please open a Brooklyn branch!).

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Karen, Lori, Deborah, and the entire medical team at Brilliant Vet. They took such incredible care of my golden retriever, Bailey, and from start to finish, they were nothing short of amazing. It’s …
Office staff is amazing. Nurse and doctors are kind and caring
